binary_reward_calibration.analytic_result: For binary accuracy and constant format/overlong, any strictly increasing two-value calibration is r_new=c+s*r_raw, s>0. With epsilon0, per-group standardized advantages are identical; zero-variance membership is unchanged.
binary_reward_calibration.claim_limit: This is an analytic/effective-epsilon null-control diagnosis, not actual calibration rollouts or proof of identical finite-precision optimizer trajectories. Mixed-format/nonconstant-length groups lie outside the invariance premise and are excluded by the current active gate.
binary_reward_calibration.finite_epsilon_exact_factor: A_new/A_raw=(std_raw+epsilon)/(std_raw+epsilon/s); nonzero epsilon changes magnitude slightly, not sign or which binary groups are informative.

diagnostic_only_correction.affected: Only reported calibration epsilon magnitudes and hypothetical-grid values; no training, checkpoint, raw signal count or C40 metric changed.
diagnostic_only_correction.defect: Diagnostic used sigmoid((accuracy-p50)/IQR), whereas frozen training uses sigmoid(3*(accuracy-p50)/IQR).
diagnostic_only_correction.recomputation: 39 actual accepted grade vectors from125 individually hash-authenticated receipt JSONs; no raw response/decoder/Adam-array replay.

engineering_bug.action: Fix only a concrete reproduced defect; no broad optimizer re-audit.
engineering_bug.evidence: Raw route/targets/image-to-schedule hashes and saved reward/advantage/cursor numerics are checked here; previous native Adam/checkpoint proof accepted. Native GSPO ratio/gradient formula belongs to separate targeted numerical fixture.

optimization_method.action: Complete frozen specialist/proportional/uniform seeds and mechanistic calibration comparison; interpret actual effective exposure.
optimization_method.evidence: One stochastic seed with39 accepted updates and lower internal-dev macro does not identify GSPO ineffectiveness; binary monotone reward calibration is largely advantage-invariant.

scientific_data_validity.action: Separate predetermined training/internal-dev no-image, truth-updated image substitutions and fixed-prefix likelihood controls; sealed test remains closed.
scientific_data_validity.evidence: Saved categorical counts cannot distinguish relevant visual evidence from answer priors, whole-head/intensity shortcuts or source/task confounding.

statistical_uncertainty.action: Finish frozen seeds and shared evaluations; avoid claiming independent-patient or clinical generalization.
statistical_uncertainty.evidence: Four sequence people/four matched cycles; classwise paired errors and cluster bootstrap/sign flips provided, not40 independent patients.

task_reward_design.action: Preserve original18 arms; test a separate correction only if frozen controls establish its need. Do not change reward to manufacture updates.
task_reward_design.evidence: Compare attempted, informative and accepted groups by true class plus generated-answer skew; active filtering alters realized update balance.

limitations: On-policy training quartiles change both sampled examples and current policy; they are not paired evaluation curves or causal learning estimates.
Source-namespaced unique people/image counts describe exposure, not verified global cross-source patient independence.
One seed/internal-dev repeatedly examined; no test access, new model computation, clinical validity or Vero-transfer success claim.
No raw identifiers, noncategorical answer text, per-case responses, paths to patient images or patient-level rows are exported.

paired_C40.macro_interval: NOT_ESTIMATED: no assumption of independent cross-source units, no simultaneous macro coverage or training-seed uncertainty claim
paired_C40.scope: Previously examined internal-dev only; four sequence people and four Dallas cycles. No independence across source namespaces or prospective-test generalization established.

cluster_uncertainty.interpretation: Descriptive paired cluster uncertainty; sign-flip requires symmetric/exchangeable null signs, not a randomized-training causal test. Four clusters provide coarse uncertainty; no population coverage claim.
